saw_lines: Traders compare prop firms on price and evaluation rules, then pay again for a new account when one breaks.
So the sale is won in the first line, with the price and the offer. A trader who must read down to find the discount has already left.
Your site offers 55% off and accounts from $45, yet 0 of 17 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 55% off and accounts from $45, yet 0 of 17 copy ads mention any discount. A trader has no reason to act today. Put the 55% off in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

None of your 17 copy ads carries a proof number, so claims stand on words alone. Traders check whether a firm pays, and one figure answers that. Collect one count, like orders shipped, and lead every new ad with it.

5 of your 17 copy ads open on “I’ve withdrawn over $12,000,” and the rest are single use. Skipping that line means meeting no second angle. Test two openers, one on the price objection and one on a trader’s first week.
All 26 of your live ads are video, so a shopper who watched one has no still to see. Make three images of a payout screen and an account page, and run them to people who already clicked.
